description:
Introducing Daisy, the handmade Mixie Bicycle from Heritage Bicycles in Chicago. Perfect for city commuters who demand a sleek, sophisticated, and easy-to-ride bike.

Crafted with care and attention to detail, Daisy is available in two sizes, small and large, ensuring a comfortable ride for every cyclist. The mixie design offers the perfect balance between a traditional road bike and a comfortable city bike, making it versatile enough for any type of riding.

The frame is handcrafted using lightweight steel, and the sleek design boasts a minimalist look that's both classic and modern. The single speed drivetrain is easy to maintain and perfect for navigating city streets, while the coaster brake ensures quick and safe stops. The Daisy's handlebars are designed for a comfortable and upright riding position, which reduces strain on the back and shoulders.

Daisy's unique design features a stunning cream-colored finish with intricate hand-painted details, making it a true work of art that will turn heads wherever you go. The leather saddle and grips provide a comfortable and stylish touch that adds to the bike's overall sophistication.

In summary, Daisy is the perfect bike for city commuters who demand both style and function. Handmade in Chicago, this mixie bicycle is a true testament to Heritage Bicycle's dedication to quality and craftsmanship. With its effortless riding experience and easy-to-maintain components, Daisy is a bike you'll enjoy riding for years to come.

SHE REPRESENTS OUR DESIRE TO APPEAL TO EVERY RIDER BY MAKING BIKES THAT ARE CLASSY, CLASSIC, AND THAT WILL LOOK AT HOME PARKED AGAINST A WHITE-PICKET FENCE OR CHURNING UP GRAVEL IN CHICAGO’S INFAMOUS POTHOLES.

MADE IN THE USA, DURABLE WITH ATTENTION TO EVERY DETAIL. HANDCRAFTED, ONE AT A TIME, TO ENSURE A QUALITY RIDE THAT LASTS FOR A LIFETIME.

EACH HERITAGE DAISY IS MANUFACTURED BY HAND, ONE AT A TIME. PLEASE ALLOW 4 TO 6 WEEKS FOR DELIVERY.
